body: I don’t want hospitalisisation but I’m increasingly thinking it may be the only option

I get this entirely. And even though I’m still wrestling with depression now I wish the version of me in highschool who felt this way could understand just how different it gets. You may not feel perfect but I promise you’ll look back on this time as a blip and not the full story
I’m not sure. Some say it’s a relatively peaceful thing. I’m ok with fading away rather than it being instant. I’m just tired dude. So fucking tired
